title.hu: Óvatos fogalmazás (This may indicate …, It appears that …, tend to)
title.en: Hedging Language (This may indicate …, It appears that …, tend to)
title.es: El lenguaje atenuado (This may indicate …, It appears that …, tend to)
title.de: Abschwächende Sprache (This may indicate …, It appears that …, tend to)

text.hu: Az óvatos fogalmazás (hedging) azt jelzi, hogy valami nem teljesen biztos vagy nem mindenkire igaz. Tudományos, szakmai és udvarias nyelvben gyakori: „This may indicate a problem.” (Ez problémára utalhat.) „Young people tend to use phones more.” (A fiatalok hajlamosak többet használni.) Eszközei: módbeli igék (may, might, could), igék (seem, appear, tend, suggest), határozószók (probably, arguably, generally), szerkezetek (it is likely that, to some extent). A spanyol „podría”, „parece que”, „tiende a”, „es probable que” felel meg nekik.
text.en: Hedging signals that something is not completely certain or not true for everyone. It is common in academic, professional and polite language: “This may indicate a problem.” “Young people tend to use phones more.” Its tools are modal verbs (may, might, could), verbs (seem, appear, tend, suggest), adverbs (probably, arguably, generally) and structures (it is likely that, to some extent). The Spanish “podría”, “parece que”, “tiende a” and “es probable que” match them.
text.es: El lenguaje atenuado (hedging) indica que algo no es del todo seguro o no vale para todos. Es común en el lenguaje académico, profesional y cortés: «This may indicate a problem.» «Young people tend to use phones more.» Sus herramientas son los verbos modales (may, might, could), los verbos (seem, appear, tend, suggest), los adverbios (probably, arguably, generally) y las estructuras (it is likely that, to some extent). El «podría», el «parece que», el «tiende a» y el «es probable que» del español les corresponden.
text.de: Abschwächende Sprache (Hedging) zeigt, dass etwas nicht ganz sicher oder nicht für alle wahr ist. Sie ist in akademischer, beruflicher und höflicher Sprache üblich: «This may indicate a problem.» «Young people tend to use phones more.» Ihre Mittel sind Modalverben (may, might, could), Verben (seem, appear, tend, suggest), Adverbien (probably, arguably, generally) und Strukturen (it is likely that, to some extent). Das spanische «podría», «parece que», «tiende a» und «es probable que» entsprechen ihnen.

text.hu: A may, a might és a could lehetőséget jelez, nem biztosat. A will és a must biztosságot fejez ki, ezért óvatos szövegben ritkábbak: „This may be due to stress.” „It could suggest a problem.”
text.en: May, might and could mark a possibility, not a certainty. Will and must express certainty, so they are rarer in careful text: “This may be due to stress.” “It could suggest a problem.”
text.es: May, might y could marcan una posibilidad, no una certeza. Will y must expresan certeza, por eso son más raros en un texto cuidadoso: «This may be due to stress.» «It could suggest a problem.»
text.de: May, might und could markieren eine Möglichkeit, keine Gewissheit. Will und must drücken Gewissheit aus, deshalb sind sie in vorsichtigen Texten seltener: «This may be due to stress.» «It could suggest a problem.»

title.hu: Óvatos igék: seem, appear, tend, suggest, indicate
title.en: Hedging verbs: seem, appear, tend, suggest, indicate
title.es: Verbos atenuantes: seem, appear, tend, suggest, indicate
title.de: Abschwächende Verben: seem, appear, tend, suggest, indicate

text.hu: A seem és az appear után to-infinitív vagy that-mondat áll. A tend to általános hajlamot jelent. A suggest és az indicate gyengébb, mint a prove: „The results suggest that the method works.”
text.en: After seem and appear comes a to-infinitive or a that-clause. Tend to means a general tendency. Suggest and indicate are weaker than prove: “The results suggest that the method works.”
text.es: Después de seem y appear va un to-infinitivo o una cláusula con that. Tend to significa una tendencia general. Suggest e indicate son más débiles que prove: «The results suggest that the method works.»
text.de: Nach seem und appear steht ein to-Infinitiv oder ein that-Satz. Tend to bedeutet eine allgemeine Neigung. Suggest und indicate sind schwächer als prove: «The results suggest that the method works.»

text.hu: Probably, possibly, arguably, apparently, generally, relatively, somewhat; to some extent, in most cases, to a certain degree. Az absztrakt „always, never, all” helyett gyakran „often, rarely, most” áll.
text.en: Probably, possibly, arguably, apparently, generally, relatively, somewhat; to some extent, in most cases, to a certain degree. Instead of the absolute “always, never, all” you often use “often, rarely, most”.
text.es: Probably, possibly, arguably, apparently, generally, relatively, somewhat; to some extent, in most cases, to a certain degree. En lugar de los absolutos «always, never, all» se usa a menudo «often, rarely, most».
text.de: Probably, possibly, arguably, apparently, generally, relatively, somewhat; to some extent, in most cases, to a certain degree. Statt der absoluten «always, never, all» steht oft «often, rarely, most».

text.hu: Az óvatos fogalmazás nem gyengeség, hanem pontosság: ha valami nem biztos, a will vagy az always túl erős. A túl sok hedge viszont bizonytalanná teszi a szöveget: elég egy vagy kettő mondatonként.
text.en: Hedging is not weakness but accuracy: if something is not certain, will or always is too strong. Too many hedges, however, make the text vague: one or two per sentence are enough.
text.es: El lenguaje atenuado no es debilidad sino exactitud: si algo no es seguro, will o always es demasiado fuerte. Demasiados atenuantes, en cambio, vuelven vago el texto: basta uno o dos por oración.
text.de: Abschwächende Sprache ist keine Schwäche, sondern Genauigkeit: Wenn etwas nicht sicher ist, ist will oder always zu stark. Zu viele Abschwächungen machen den Text aber vage: ein bis zwei pro Satz genügen.

text.hu: Spanyol hatás: a „puede ser que” angolul it may be that, a „a lo mejor” perhaps. A „tiende a” angolban tends to, a többes számú alanynál tend to: „Young people tend to…”.
text.en: Spanish influence: the Spanish “puede ser que” is it may be that in English, and “a lo mejor” is perhaps. The Spanish “tiende a” is tends to, and with a plural subject tend to: “Young people tend to…”.
text.es: Influencia del español: el «puede ser que» del español es it may be that en inglés, y «a lo mejor» es perhaps. El «tiende a» es tends to, y con sujeto plural tend to: «Young people tend to…».
text.de: Einfluss des Spanischen: das spanische «puede ser que» ist im Englischen it may be that, und «a lo mejor» ist perhaps. Das spanische «tiende a» ist tends to, und bei Plural-Subjekt tend to: «Young people tend to…».

A szerkezetek: «it is likely that», «to some extent», «in most cases». Udvarias kérésnél: «I was wondering if you could help me».

speak.es: El lenguaje atenuado indica que algo no es del todo seguro o no vale para todos. Sus herramientas son «may», «might» y «could»: «This may indicate a problem».
